parts.text: You are provided with solid S . Do the following tests on solid S , recording all of your observations at each stage. tests on solid S To the boiling tube containing solid S add about 20 cm 3 of distilled water. Stopper the boiling tube and shake the mixture to dissolve solid S and form solution T . Divide solution T into six approximately equal portions in six test-tubes.

parts.text: (a) State the colour change that occurred when distilled water was added to solid S to form solution T . from solid S .................................................. to solution T ................................................... [1]
